description: Facts about XACT (.xap) features used by the converter. status is 'confirmed' or 'expected, unverified'. Nothing is copied from any third-party file; sources name where each fact was read.

features.meaning: Hundredths of a decibel. gain = 10^(value/2000). 0 is unity gain.
features.source: Real .xap files read in the spec research (values such as -1200 and 203); archived XACT documentation could not be reached for a direct statement.

features.meaning: Hundredths of a semitone in the .xap, range -1200 to 1200, mapped to the XNA pitch range -1 to 1. MonoGame divides pitch variation values in compiled banks by 1000, so the two disagree.
features.source: Every pitch value in the real files read is 0. MonoGame v3.8.6.1 Audio/Xact/XactClip.cs divides by 1000.
MonoGame v3.8.6.1 Audio/Xact/PlayWaveEvent.cs: IsLooped is set when the loop count is 255 and the event has one track; the finite counter is skipped for 255.

features.meaning: A count from 1 to 254 repeats the wave N more times after the first play.
features.source: MonoGame v3.8.6.1 Audio/Xact/PlayWaveEvent.cs Update: replays while the loop index is below the loop count.
MonoGame v3.8.6.1 Audio/Xact/PlayWaveEvent.cs Update: stops when the loop count is 0.
